whatIs.title: What is the Youth Rent Subsidy?
whatIs.description: A Korean government program supporting ages 19-34 who live independently without home ownership, providing up to ₩200K/month for up to 12 months (total ₩2.4M). Both parent household income and personal income/assets are verified.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Enter your age and independent living status
Enter personal income/assets and parent household income
Enter current rent and deposit amounts
Click 'Check Eligibility' to see pass/fail for each of 7 conditions
Review any failed conditions to see if they can be resolved

tips.title: Useful Tips
items: If rent is below ₩200K, only the actual rent amount is supported
Deposit must be ₩50M or less and rent ₩700K or less
Living at the same address as parents does not count as independent
Income is calculated based on health insurance premiums
Results are typically notified within 1-2 months after application

items.q: Can I reapply if I received it before?
items.a: You can apply for the remaining period only. Total support cannot exceed 12 months.
Gosiwon with lease agreements are eligible, but school dormitories are generally excluded.
To assess the youth's actual economic situation, parent household income is also verified. Parent income must be below 100% of median income.
